fact: The June 2024 implementation support mission recorded the US$67 million EA-RDIP broadband project (approved 2023-05-18, closing 2028-05-31) and that a consultant was developing the South Sudan Digital Development Road Map/Master Plan, with draft recommendations consulted.
title: Republic of South Sudan, Eastern Africa Regional Digital Integration Project (P176181): EA-RDIP Implementation Support Mission, Juba, June 3-7, 2024, Aide-Memoire
